findings.detail: Thirty-two December 31, 2025 schedule rows were retained as positions for the March 31, 2026 report date.

rationale: The filing index labels the current Schedule of Investments as of March 31, 2026 at table 5 row 10 and separately labels the comparative Schedule of Investments as of December 31, 2025 at table 5 row 11. A flagged example, Titan BW Borrower L.P. First Lien Revolver, is present in the December 31, 2025 schedule at table 23 row 13, while its current-period counterpart is at table 11 row 14. The 32 flagged earlier-period rows are therefore comparative copies, not current-quarter positions, and should not be retained in the March 31, 2026 holdings population. No aggregate anchor is needed for this row-disposition defect.
